PalmCraft Cabinets · (813) 670-9080

Questions Homeowners Ask Us

How much do custom kitchen cabinets cost in Tampa?

PalmCraft custom kitchens start from $10,000 — that is a 12-linear-foot kitchen with design, delivery, and installation included. The final price depends on the size of the kitchen, the door style, materials and finishes, and accessories. You receive a full itemized quote upfront, with no hidden fees, after a free consultation.

How long does a custom kitchen take?

Production takes up to 6 weeks from final design approval and the first deposit. Delivery and installation are scheduled after you inspect the finished cabinets. Your timeline is confirmed in the contract.

What warranty do you offer?

PalmCraft provides a 24-month warranty on its installation work. Manufacturers' and suppliers' warranties on materials, hardware, and appliances are passed on to you. Full terms are in our Terms and Conditions.

How does payment work?

You pay in four steps as the work moves forward: 50% deposit after you approve the design, 30% when your cabinets are built, 15% after installation, and the final 5% once the punch list is complete — so the last payment comes only when your kitchen is finished. PalmCraft accepts credit card, Apple Pay, and ACH transfer.

Do you offer financing?

Financing is not currently available. PalmCraft is working on adding it; ask during your consultation for the latest status.

Do you install the cabinets?

Yes. PalmCraft delivers and professionally installs its own cabinetry throughout Tampa Bay. If you have your own contractor, PalmCraft can also manufacture and deliver cabinets for self-installation.

Can you install cabinets I bought somewhere else?

No. PalmCraft installs only cabinetry it designs and supplies, so that the quality and warranty stay under one team's responsibility.

What cabinet styles do you make?

PalmCraft works in two main directions: American classic shaker and European modern flat-panel, including handleless designs. Sizes, colors, finishes, and hardware are custom to your project.

What areas do you serve?

PalmCraft serves Tampa Bay from its Oldsmar workshop, including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Palm Harbor, Largo, and nearby communities. Projects in Sarasota, Miami, and other parts of Florida are possible depending on order size and scope.

Is the estimate free?

Yes. The in-home measurement, consultation, estimate, and 3D design are free with no obligation. Send the form or call (813) 670-9080 and PalmCraft will reply within 2 hours during business hours.

How quickly do you respond?

During business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM) PalmCraft calls back within minutes. Simple questions are answered within the hour and detailed ones the same day, and every project gets its own WhatsApp group.

Can you work with my interior designer?

Yes. Our designer works alongside your designer, not instead of them, and handles the cabinetry drawings, 3D design, and production.

How many design changes are included?

Two rounds of design changes are included in the price, and you review everything in 3D before production starts.

Can you do the whole house, not just the kitchen?

Yes. PalmCraft designs the kitchen, pantry, laundry, closets, vanities, TV wall, and stair treads as one system, so finishes and details match from room to room.

Where are you located and when are you open?

PalmCraft's workshop and appointment location is at 343 Douglas Rd E, #1, Oldsmar, FL 34677. Hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Visits are by appointment only.
